steps.description:
Show that your robot can perform the following:
1. Create a variable named Attack Power
2. Assign the value 100 to the variable Attack Power
3. Display the variable Attack on the LCD Screen for 2 seconds with the following format:
Attack Power : 100

The program can only be terminated when the stop button on the blockly interface is clicked.

Show that your robot can perform the following:
1. Create a variable named Attack Power
2. Assign the value 100 to the variable Attack Power
3. Display "Press and hold to charge attack" on the LCD screen until the Button is pressed.
4. When the Button is pressed and held, display the variable Attack on the LCD Screen for 2 seconds with the following format:

Attack Power : 100

5. When the Button is released, repeat step 3.

The program can only be terminated when the stop button on the blockly interface is clicked.

Show that your robot can perform the following:
1. Create a variable named Attack Power
2. Display "Press and hold to charge attack" on the LCD screen until the Button is pressed
3. When Button is pressed and held
- Attack Power will always start from 0
- Attack Power will increase by 10 per second
- Display "Charging" on the LCD Screen
4. When Button is released, display the Attack Power value on the LCD screen for 2 second with the following format:

Attack Power : #

Example 1:
If you increase the Attack Power to 100, you will see this on the LCD screen
Attack Power : 100

Example 2:
If you increase the Attack Power to 20, you will see this on the LCD screen
Attack Power : 20

5. Repeat step 2

The program can only be terminated when the stop button on the blockly interface is clicked.

Show that your robot can perform the following:
1. Create a variable named Attack Power
2. Display "Press and hold to charge attack" on the LCD screen
3. When Button is pressed and held
- Attack Power will always start from 0
- Attack Power will increase by 10 per second
- When the Attack Power is 100 or below, displays "Charging" on the LCD Screen
- When the Attack Power is more than 100, plays a sound and displays "Overcharging" on the LCD Screen
4. When Button is released
- Display the Attack Power on the LCD screen for 2 second with the following format:

Attack Power : #

Example 1:
If you increase the Attack Power to 100, you will see this on the LCD screen
Attack Power : 100

Example 2:
If you increase the Attack Power to 20, you will see this on the LCD screen
Attack Power : 20

5. Repeat step 2

The program can only be terminated when the stop button on the blockly interface is clicked.

Show that your robot can perform the following:
1. Create a variable named Attack Power
2. Display "Press and hold to charge attack"" on the LCD screen
3. When Button is pressed and held
- Attack Power will always start from 0
- Attack Power will increase by 10 per second
- When the Attack Power is 100 or below, displays "Charging" on top row of the LCD Screen
- When the Attack Power is more than 100, displays "Overcharging" on the top row of the LCD Screen and plays a sound for 1 second
4. When Button is released
- If your Attack Power is overcharged, perform step 2 again,
- If you Attack Power is not overcharged, perform the next step.
5. Display the Attack Power on the LCD screen for 2 second with the following format:

Attack Power : #

Example 1:
If you increase the Attack Power to 100, you will see this on the LCD screen
Attack Power : 100

Example 2:
If you increase the Attack Power to 20, you will see this on the LCD screen
Attack Power : 20

6. Repeat step 2

The program can only be terminated when the stop button on the blockly interface is clicked.
